entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
...... .... Petitioner(s) Versus The State
of Jharkhand ..... .... Opp. Party

--------
Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ambuj Nath
--------

For the Petitioner(s) : Mr. Gaurav Abhishekh, Advocate For the State : Mr. Ajay Kr. Pathak, A.P. P.
--------
02/ Dated 11.04.2025 Heard the parties.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Chiniya P.S. Case No. 07 of 2024,
corresponding to S.T. Case No.19 of 2025, for the offence registered under Sections 366 & 376 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of Sri Dinesh Kumar, learned Additional Sessions Judge-I,
Garhwa.
On 20.01.2024 at about 5:30 p.m., petitioner is alleged to have kidnapped the victim and took her to an isolated place and raped her.
The medical report does not support the allegation.
Considering the nature of allegation, I am not inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly,
the prayer for bail of the petitioner is hereby rejected.

(Ambuj Nath, J.) BS/-
